UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user profile and cloud library summary stored at /users/{userId}.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning user.

displayName.description: User display name from Google Sign-In.

email.description: Optional email address of the signed-in user (strictly owner-only access).

photoUrl.description: Optional avatar URL from Google Sign-In.

totalBooksSynced.description: Count of books synced to the user's cloud library.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() upon profile creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on every update.

CloudBookRecord.title: CloudBookRecord
CloudBookRecord.description: Synced EPUB book metadata and reading progress belonging to a specific user.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning user.

originalFileName.description: Original PDF or EPUB source filename.

lastReadChapterIndex.description: Zero-based index of the last read chapter.

favorite.description: Whether the book is starred as a favorite.

completed.description: Whether the book has been marked as completed.

convertedAtMillis.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when the book was converted or imported.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on every update.

CloudReadingSession.title: CloudReadingSession
CloudReadingSession.description: Immutable reading session record synced to the user's analytics log.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning user.

bookKey.description: Stable cloud document key of the associated book.

bookTitle.description: Title of the book read during this session.

pagesRead.description: Number of pages read during this session.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

CloudHighlight.title: CloudHighlight
CloudHighlight.description: Synced book highlight and optional reader note.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning user.

bookKey.description: Stable cloud document key of the associated book.

note.description: Optional user note attached to the highlight.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning user.

bookKey.description: Stable cloud document key of the associated book.

snippet.description: Text snippet around the bookmarked position.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-only user profile document storing Google account metadata and synced library count.

/users/{userId}/books/{bookId}.description: User-scoped collection of synced EPUB book metadata and reading progress.

/users/{userId}/reading_sessions/{sessio.description: User-scoped collection of reading analytics sessions.

/users/{userId}/highlights/{highlightId}.description: User-scoped collection of book highlights and reader notes.

/users/{userId}/bookmarks/{bookmarkId}.description: User-scoped collection of saved reader bookmarks.
